broilerModels.name: High-Volume QSR Conveyor Charbroiler (125,000 BTU/hr, 900 Patties/hr, Dual-Belt)
broilerModels.description: Standard high-capacity automated conveyor charbroiler used in commercial hamburger chains; dual-lane mesh belt with upper and lower ribbon gas burners and top-mounted catalytic converter.

broilerModels.name: Compact Fast-Casual Conveyor Broiler (65,000 BTU/hr, 450 Patties/hr, Single-Belt)
broilerModels.description: Single-belt automated conveyor broiler for express kitchens; lower burner output but smaller flue duct cross-section makes it sensitive to rapid grease particulate choking.

broilerModels.name: Industrial Commissary Mega-Broiler (210,000 BTU/hr, 1,400 Patties/hr, Tri-Belt)
broilerModels.description: High-throughput industrial commissary broiler operating continuously across multiple meal shifts; features large dual-stage ceramic monolith catalytic incinerator.

broilerModels.name: High-Speed Gas Infrared Conveyor Broiler (95,000 BTU/hr, 750 Patties/hr, Direct Impingement)
broilerModels.description: Ceramic infrared burner array creating intense direct radiant heat; generates high vaporized lipid plume velocity requiring rapid catalytic dwell time.

broilerModels.name: Legacy 18-Year Commercial Broiler (110,000 BTU/hr, Poor Burner Air Ratio, Warped Honeycomb Frame)
broilerModels.description: Heavily utilized legacy unit with distorted exhaust transition plenum, leaky bypass seals, degraded burner aspirators, and chronic incomplete combustion soot generation.

pattyGreaseProfiles.name: Standard 80/20 Ground Beef Patty (20% Raw Fat Content, 115g Raw Weight)
pattyGreaseProfiles.description: Standard commercial quick-service burger patty; significant lipid vaporization creates high grease-aerosol volumetric density in exhaust gases.

pattyGreaseProfiles.name: High-Fat 75/25 Ground Chuck Patty (25% Raw Fat Content, 150g Quarter-Pounder)
pattyGreaseProfiles.description: High-fat beef blend; intense fat rendering generates heavy flare-ups and massive smoke plumes that rapidly overwhelm uncleaned catalyst honeycombs.

pattyGreaseProfiles.name: Lean 90/10 Sirloin Patty (10% Raw Fat Content, 115g Raw Weight)
pattyGreaseProfiles.description: Lean beef with lower lipid vapor emissions; lower exothermic reaction in catalyst core may cause operating temperature to dip below optimal 400°C activation threshold.

pattyGreaseProfiles.name: Pork Sausage Breakfast Patty (32% Fat, Sugar/Spice Additives, 85g Weight)
pattyGreaseProfiles.description: Extremely high fat coupled with sugars and seasoning spices; caramelizing sugars form heavy vitreous tar that rapidly glazes and blind-plugs catalyst pores.

pattyGreaseProfiles.name: Plant-Based Engineered Burger (Canola/Coconut Oil Emulsion, 18% Fat, 115g Weight)
pattyGreaseProfiles.description: Refined vegetable oil emulsion creates fine ultrafine sub-micron oil droplets; high smoke volatility and volatile short-chain fatty acids.

catalystStates.name: Factory Clean & Regenerated (0% Honeycomb Occlusion, Active Pt/Pd Washcoat)
catalystStates.description: Freshly installed or ultrasonically chemical-cleaned monolith; open porous honeycomb channels with pristine noble metal catalytic reaction sites.

catalystStates.name: Light Soot & Surface Carbon (15% Channel Occlusion, Minor Ash Glazing)
catalystStates.description: Normal intermediate operating condition after 3 to 5 operating days without full thermal regenerative bake-out; minimal backpressure rise.

catalystStates.name: Moderate Thermal Choke (45% Channel Occlusion, Heavy Vitreous Tar & Soot)
catalystStates.description: Substantial honeycomb clogging; flue gas velocity surges through remaining channels, elevating backpressure and forcing unburned grease aerosols downstream.

catalystStates.name: Severe Carbon/Ash Clog & Honeycomb Sintering (75% Occlusion, Chronic Choke)
catalystStates.description: Catastrophic honeycomb channel blockage; backpressure exceeds burner draft limits, choking combustion air and turning catalyst into a 700°C glow-plug hazard.

exhaustAirflowClasses.name: Dedicated Heavy-Duty Type I Canopy Hood (1,200 CFM, Clean Stainless Baffles)
exhaustAirflowClasses.description: Optimal NFPA 96 ventilation system; high negative static draw pulls exhaust smoothly through catalyst and maintains duct temperatures well below autoignition thresholds.

exhaustAirflowClasses.name: Standard Code-Compliant Type I Hood (900 CFM, Normal Baffle Resistance)
exhaustAirflowClasses.description: Meets minimum NFPA 96 velocity requirements (minimum 500 FPM in horizontal/vertical ducts); adequate convective dilution under normal operating loads.

exhaustAirflowClasses.name: Restricted Airflow / Grease-Loaded Baffles (600 CFM, Slipping Fan Belt)
exhaustAirflowClasses.description: Exhaust fan motor belt slipping or baffle filters saturated with grease; reduced draft allows thermal energy and grease vapors to accumulate in the broiler collar.

exhaustAirflowClasses.name: Severely Deficient Exhaust Draft (350 CFM, Blocked Duct / Failed Blower)
exhaustAirflowClasses.description: Emergency ventilation failure; minimal exhaust draw results in intense heat buildup, flue gas spillage into the kitchen, and extreme risk of autoignition flash.

catalystWashcoatMetallurgies.name: Dual Platinum/Palladium on Gamma-Alumina (5:1 Pt/Pd, 35 g/ft³ Loading)
catalystWashcoatMetallurgies.description: Industry-standard high-activity noble metal washcoat; delivers rapid catalytic oxidation of CO, acrolein, and grease aerosols across 350°C to 600°C window.

catalystWashcoatMetallurgies.name: Zeolite-Enhanced Pt/Pd Honeycomb (High Hydrothermal Stability, 45 g/ft³)
catalystWashcoatMetallurgies.description: Advanced thermal shock resistant monolith with high hydrothermal stability; maintains catalytic activity even during high moisture steam surges from frozen patties.

catalystWashcoatMetallurgies.name: Thermally Sintered Degraded Washcoat (Nanoparticle Agglomeration, 50% Active Sites)
catalystWashcoatMetallurgies.description: Previously overheated past 800°C; precious metal crystallites have agglomerated into larger inactive clusters, drastically elevating light-off activation temperature.

catalystWashcoatMetallurgies.name: Phosphorus/Sulfur Chemically Poisoned Monolith (Irreversible Surface Passivation)
catalystWashcoatMetallurgies.description: Catalyst poisoned by sulfur in low-grade fuel or organophosphates in cooking oils/cleaning chemicals; noble metal sites permanently masked.
